import json, os, time, uuid
from pathlib import Path
from scripts.aws import aws_cli

region = 'us-west-2'
account = '000000000000'
name = 'sd-missing-activity-' + uuid.uuid4().hex[:10]
observations = []
fixture_path = Path('/home/r/dev/minor/stackd/testdata/aws/stepfunctions/activity_missing.json')
state = {'account': account, 'region': region, 'caller_arn': 'arn:aws:iam::000000000000:user/Delegated', 'observations': observations, 'sources': [{'path': __file__, 'content': Path(__file__).read_text()}]}
def call(service, operation, parameters, label):
    started = time.time_ns() // 1000000
    result = aws_cli.result(aws_cli.run(service, operation, parameters, options=('--region',region,'--cli-connect-timeout','10','--cli-read-timeout','20'), timeout=35))
    observations.append({'label':label,'service':service,'operation':operation,'actor':'default','region':region,'input':parameters,'request_started_ms':started,'request_finished_ms':time.time_ns()//1000000,'result':result})
    fixture_path.write_text(json.dumps(state, indent=2)+'\n')
    return result
role = machine = execution = None
try:
    identity = call('sts','get-caller-identity',{},'caller')
    assert identity['output']['Account'] == account
    result = call('iam','create-role',{'RoleName':name,'AssumeRolePolicyDocument':json.dumps({'Version':'2012-10-17','Statement':[{'Effect':'Allow','Principal':{'Service':'states.amazonaws.com'},'Action':'sts:AssumeRole'}]})},'create-role')
    assert result['code'] == 'Success', result
    role = result['output']['Role']['Arn']
    definition = {'StartAt':'Missing','TimeoutSeconds':15,'States':{'Missing':{'Type':'Task','Resource':f'arn:aws:states:{region}:{account}:activity:{name}','End':True}}}
    for attempt in range(10):
        result = call('stepfunctions','create-state-machine',{'name':name,'roleArn':role,'definition':json.dumps(definition)},f'create-machine-{attempt}')
        if result['code'] == 'Success': break
        if result['code'] not in ('InvalidArn','AccessDeniedException'): raise RuntimeError(result)
        time.sleep(2)
    assert result['code'] == 'Success', result
    machine = result['output']['stateMachineArn']
    result = call('stepfunctions','start-execution',{'stateMachineArn':machine,'name':'missing','input':'{}'},'start')
    assert result['code'] == 'Success', result
    execution = result['output']['executionArn']
    for attempt in range(30):
        result = call('stepfunctions','describe-execution',{'executionArn':execution},f'describe-{attempt}')
        if result['output']['status'] != 'RUNNING': break
        time.sleep(1)
    result = call('stepfunctions','get-execution-history',{'executionArn':execution},'history')
    print(json.dumps(result))
finally:
    if execution:
        current = call('stepfunctions','describe-execution',{'executionArn':execution},'cleanup-status')
        if current.get('output',{}).get('status') == 'RUNNING': call('stepfunctions','stop-execution',{'executionArn':execution},'cleanup-stop')
    if machine:
        call('stepfunctions','delete-state-machine',{'stateMachineArn':machine},'cleanup-machine')
        for attempt in range(30):
            result = call('stepfunctions','describe-state-machine',{'stateMachineArn':machine},f'verify-machine-{attempt}')
            if result['code'] == 'StateMachineDoesNotExist': break
            time.sleep(1)
        assert result['code'] == 'StateMachineDoesNotExist', result
    if role:
        call('iam','delete-role',{'RoleName':name},'cleanup-role')
        result = call('iam','get-role',{'RoleName':name},'verify-role')
        assert result['code'] == 'NoSuchEntity', result
    state['cleanup'] = 'Owned machine and role independently absent; missing Activity never created. Completed execution history is AWS-retained.'
    fixture_path.write_text(json.dumps(state, indent=2)+'\n')

import json,time
from pathlib import Path
from scripts.aws import aws_cli
p=Path('/home/r/dev/minor/stackd/testdata/aws/stepfunctions/activity_missing.json')
f=json.loads(p.read_text())

def call(service,operation,parameters,label):

    p.write_text(json.dumps(f,indent=2)+'\n')
    return result
call('iam','delete-role',{'RoleName':role},'cleanup-role')
assert call('iam','get-role',{'RoleName':role},'verify-role')['code']=='NoSuchEntity'
for i in range(90):
    result=call('stepfunctions','describe-state-machine',{'stateMachineArn':machine},f'verify-machine-converged-{i}')
    if result['code']=='StateMachineDoesNotExist': break
    time.sleep(2)
assert result['code']=='StateMachineDoesNotExist',result
f['cleanup']='Owned machine and role independently absent; missing Activity never created. Completed execution history is AWS-retained.'
p.write_text(json.dumps(f,indent=2)+'\n')
print(f['cleanup'])
